factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025: 'In the fourth quarter, natural gas consumption... totalled 11.5 TWh, decreasing by 2% compared with the previous year... Elenger Grupp gas and electricity sales volumes... increased by 7% compared to a year earlier, totalling 4.8 TWh... Elenger gas sales market share... remained at... 21%...'

factual_claims.claim: The company signed a multi-year agreement for LNG supplies and continued expanding its battery-based energy storage systems.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025: 'Elenger Grupp has signed in Q4 a multi-year agreement to diversify and secure LNG energy supplies... Elenger Grupp continued its activities in the FuelEU Maritime market... At the end of September, Elenger commissioned its first battery-based energy storage system... and has now started construction of a similar system...'

factual_claims.claim: Financial position metrics showed improved leverage.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025: Net debt/EBITDA improved to 3.6 (2025) from 4.0 (2024). Also, equity ratio increased to 45.5% from 43.0%.

factual_claims.claim: Net debt decreased to EUR 841 million from EUR 1.06 billion, and the net debt to EBITDA ratio improved to 3.6 from 4.0.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025: Net debt (in thousands of EUR) 2025: 840 682; 2024: 1 055 708. Net debt/EBITDA 2025: 3,6; 2024: 4,0

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities fell to EUR 1.06 billion from EUR 1.22 billion, reflecting loan repayments across several group entities, including Tallink.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Report of Financial Position: Interest-bearing liabilities (in thousands of EUR) 2025: 1 060 453; 2024: 1 223 287. Events in Q4 2025 mentions repayment of Tallink Grupp long-term loans.

factual_claims.claim: Total equity increased slightly to EUR 1.18 billion from EUR 1.17 billion, resulting in an equity ratio of 45.5% compared to 43.0% in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Report of Financial Position: Total equity (in thousands of EUR) 2025: 1 177 516; 2024: 1 166 221. Key Figures: Equity ratio 45,5% (2025) vs 43,0% (2024)

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents rose to EUR 220 million from EUR 168 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: Cash at the end of the period (in thousands of EUR) 2025: 219 771; 2024: 167 579

factual_claims.claim: The group maintained a conservative balance sheet with strong liquidity, supporting its strategy of stable cash flow generation and long-term investment in sectors like agriculture and energy infrastructure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO: 'Strong liquidity and prudent leverage give us the freedom to make decisions with a long-term perspective... We have increasingly expanded into agriculture... Food production, energy and infrastructure are not short-term trends, but essential foundations of the economy.'
